SELECT ROUND(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)", 6) AS eligible_rate
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 5
note: Ownership code read as schools.SOC='66' (no DOC 66 exists); rate = FRPM count / enrollment, K-12.

SELECT s.MailStreet, s.School
FROM satscores a JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = a.cds
WHERE a.rtype = 'S' AND a.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
note: School-level SAT rows only (district rows excluded).

WHERE s.CDSCode = '01611920113902' AND s.County = 'Alameda' AND s.EILCode = 'HS'
AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12'

SELECT s.School, s.Phone
FROM schools s JOIN satscores a ON a.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '03' AND a.rtype = 'S'
AND a.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(a2.NumGE1500) FROM schools s2 JOIN satscores a2 ON a2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.DOC = '03' AND a2.rtype = 'S')
note: Statewide benefit charter = DOC 03; district-level SAT row excluded.

SELECT substr(GSoffered, 1, instr(GSoffered || '-', '-') - 1) AS lowest_grade
FROM schools
WHERE NCESDist = '0632640' AND School IS NOT NULL AND GSoffered IS NOT NULL AND GSoffered <> ''
ORDER BY CASE substr(GSoffered, 1, instr(GSoffered || '-', '-') - 1) WHEN 'P' THEN -1 WHEN 'K' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(substr(GSoffered, 1, instr(GSoffered || '-', '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) END
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.SOCType AS "School Type", s.School, s.Latitude
FROM schools s
WHERE (s.SOCType = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)' OR s.School LIKE '%Middle%')
AND s.Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM schools WHERE SOCType = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)' OR School LIKE '%Middle%')
note: School Type taken from schools.SOCType (same value as frpm School Type; closed schools lack frpm rows).

SELECT s.School, s.District, s.County, a.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools s JOIN satscores a ON a.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed' AND a.rtype = 'S' AND a.AvgScrWrite = (
  SELECT MAX(a2.AvgScrWrite) FROM schools s2 JOIN satscores a2 ON a2.cds = s2.CDSCode
  WHERE s2.StatusType = 'Closed' AND a2.rtype = 'S' AND a2.AvgScrWrite < (
    SELECT MAX(a3.AvgScrWrite) FROM schools s3 JOIN satscores a3 ON a3.cds = s3.CDSCode WHERE s3.StatusType = 'Closed' AND a3.rtype = 'S'))

SELECT s.County AS county_name,
       COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
       ROUND(AVG(ROUND(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)", 2)), 2) AS avg_free_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(ROUND(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)", 2)), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_schools,
       ROUND(AVG(a.AvgScrRead + a.AvgScrMath + a.AvgScrWrite), 2) AS avg_sat
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores a ON a.cds = f.CDSCode AND a.rtype = 'S'
WHERE s.County = (SELECT County FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = '01612590125716')
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
GROUP BY s.County
note: Read 'K-12' as the K-12 count columns, not a school-type filter; only 1 school in range has SAT.

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS magnet_provision2_schools
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY s.City ORDER BY s.City
note: Exact 'Provision 2' only; city spellings as in data.

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."School Type" IN ('High Schools (Public)', 'Continuation High Schools', 'High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)')
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
ORDER BY s.School
